set.body: Scope: PRD Phase 9. Introduce namespaced object and representation identities, typed payload roles, a narrow representation descriptor envelope, distinct archive and representation versions, a pure legacy LNA translator, and the admitted canonical writer. Acceptance: old and new fixtures read; the canonical writer emits only the new form; unknown representations remain structurally validatable; migration is pure and fixture-tested; logical payload identity is stable across physical layouts; format-specific external conformance remains green.
set.title: RRA 9: normalize the NeuroArchive manifest and legacy translation
